annotations.text:
Sudhanshu — portfolio prototype

Light editorial direction: warm paper, deep ink, one clay accent.

Type: Instrument Serif (display) + Schibsted Grotesk (body) + JetBrains Mono (labels).

Anything in [square brackets] with a dotted underline is a placeholder waiting on your real LinkedIn details — name, companies, dates, city, email, metrics.

The project write-ups are drafted examples for a PHP/Laravel backend role. Swap in your actual projects.
Each artboard has an accent colour control above it — four presets (clay, forest, indigo, bronze) or pick your own.
